summary: The no_valid_comparison closure holds. The authors estimated WT minus Ube3a duplication within females. HypoExplorer estimated duplication minus WT across both sexes. Journal Table S3 covers prefrontal cortex. All 69 source hashes and sizes matched, and all six computations replayed. The correction identifies 723 as significant annotation rows and distinguishes 20,348 published symbols from 20,689 features used for FDR adjustment. Two saved Mendeley responses were 404 errors. The corrected proposal passed validation.
openIssues: The reviewed sources provide zero eligible gene-level pairs for the registered hypothalamic contrast. Author concordance remains unassessed.
The number of distinct Ensembl IDs among the 723 significant hypothalamic sex-effect rows remains unverified.
